questions.question: What is class for?
options: A unique name that may appear only once on the page.
A way to identify several elements as a group, different from the others.
A required attribute on every tag.
The only way to make a heading.
questions.explanation: Rather than uniquely identifying one element, class identifies several elements as being different from the other elements on the page.

A CSS position: fixed bar, always.
